reading.body:
The Tennessee Processing Center LLC sits at 436 Woodfolk Avenue in Nashville. No operator has been identified and no power specification has been published for this facility. It is mapped in OpenStreetMap as a building at this address, but without a website, operator statement, or other public specification, nothing about its capacity or AI suitability can be read from available sources.

Tennessee has 24 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 publish power figures totaling 12.13 MW. This facility ranks fifth in the state by published megawatts, which means it does not appear in that published set and contributes zero to the state's disclosed capacity. The state's small published total and the presence of 20 unmeasured facilities suggest that most Tennessee capacity remains undisclosed.

This campus cannot be evaluated for AI relevance without basic facts: operator identity, power supply capacity, cooling capability, and electricity terms. The building exists and is named, but it is otherwise opaque. Future research with access to operator websites, filings, or manual review may resolve whether this is an active facility, what loads it hosts, and whether it matters to AI infrastructure planning.
